questions.q: What was the master holding when he came into the stable?
choices: An open letter
A new bridle
A bag of oats
A riding whip
questions.evidence: held an open letter in his hand

questions.q: How did John answer when the master asked if James wasted time when out with the horses?
choices: He strongly defended James as honest and steady
He agreed that James was often careless and slow
He said he could not really say either way
He said James ought to be sent away at once
questions.evidence: a steadier, pleasanter, honester, smarter young fellow I never had in this stable

questions.q: Why had the master asked John all those questions about James?
choices: To quickly learn John's true opinion of James
Because he had believed someone's bad report of him
Because he had already decided to send James away
Because James had been rude to him that morning
questions.evidence: if I beat the bush on this side the birds would fly out

questions.q: Who wrote the letter asking for a trustworthy young groom?
choices: Sir Clifford Williams of Clifford Hall
Farmer Grey, who hated check-reins
Captain Langley, who owned the grays
Mr. Blomefield, the vicar of the parish
questions.evidence: I have a letter from my brother-in-law, Sir Clifford Williams

questions.q: How old would James be next May?
choices: Nineteen
Twenty-one
Sixteen
Twenty-five

questions.q: How did John feel about James possibly leaving?
choices: He would miss him but would not stand in his way
He was glad to see him go and said so plainly
He begged the master to keep James at Birtwick
He was angry with Sir Clifford for asking for him
questions.evidence: I would not stand in his light for the world

questions.q: What happened after it was settled that James would go to Clifford Hall?
choices: James drove the carriage often to get practice
James packed his box and left the next morning
John was hurt and stopped speaking to James
Black Beauty was sold to Sir Clifford as well
questions.evidence: in the meantime he was to get all the practice in driving

questions.q: Why did the master drive through busy city streets and to the railway station on Saturdays?
choices: To give James practice driving in hard places
To buy a great many things in the town shops
To meet the trains that brought their friends
Because the quiet country roads were all closed
questions.evidence: that bridge wanted good horses and good drivers
